WITH per_id AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) AS avg_ana
    FROM Examination
    WHERE ANA IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ana) AS mean_of_id_averages
    FROM per_id
)
SELECT p.ID,
       p.avg_ana,
       p.avg_ana - o.mean_of_id_averages AS gap_above_mean
FROM per_id AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE p.avg_ana > o.mean_of_id_averages
ORDER BY gap_above_mean DESC, p.ID ASC
LIMIT 10;
